turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics.
Pranay Palle,
How may I help you today?
Hi, this is Asher Pranay Palle. I’d like to schedule a new-patient appointment. I've been having knee pain for about a week now.
Please provide your date of birth.
Sure, it's February 16, 1995.
Just to confirm, you'd like to schedule a new patient consult for knee pain you've had for about a week.
Is that correct?
Yes, that's correct. I’d like to schedule that appointment as soon as possible.
The soonest available appointments
are this Thursday, September 24 with doctor Dubey Hauser.
Would you like a morning or afternoon time?
I'd prefer a morning time, if possible.
The earliest morning slot is at 10:30AM on Thursday with doctor
Would you like to book that time?
Yes, please go ahead and book that time for me.
Your appointment is set for Thursday, September 24 at 10:30AM with doctor Judy Hauser at Pivot Point Orthopedics.
Please bring your photo ID, insurance card, a list of your current medications, and any imaging discs if you have them.
Would you like me to send you a text message with these details?
Yes, that would be great. Thank you!
You'll get a text with your appointment details soon.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help!
You're all set. Have a great day.
Thank you! You too! Goodbye!
